name: moread
description: 墨读 MoRead - 个人自用 macOS Markdown 阅读器 (Swift/AppKit + WKWebView)
author: Ruchun Zuo

scripts.test:pdf: npm run build:web && swiftc -parse-as-library -module-cache-path /tmp/moread-pdf-module-cache -target arm64-apple-macos14.0 -framework Cocoa -framework WebKit -framework PDFKit -framework UniformTypeIdentifiers src-native/PDFExporter.swift src-native/LocalFileSchemeHandler.swift tests/native/TestPDFExport.swift -o /tmp/moread-pdf-tests && /tmp/moread-pdf-tests "$PWD/dist-renderer" "$PWD/_codex_sessions/MoReadBugs/tmp/pdfs/regression"
scripts.test:renderer: npm run build:web && swiftc -parse-as-library -module-cache-path /tmp/moread-renderer-module-cache -target arm64-apple-macos14.0 -framework Cocoa -framework WebKit tests/native/TestRendererSuite.swift -o /tmp/moread-renderer-tests && /tmp/moread-renderer-tests "$PWD/dist-renderer"
scripts.test:renderer:bridge: npm run build:web && swiftc -D MOREAD_BRIDGE_INTEGRATION -parse-as-library -module-cache-path /tmp/moread-renderer-module-cache -target arm64-apple-macos14.0 -framework Cocoa -framework WebKit -framework UniformTypeIdentifiers src-native/SettingsManager.swift src-native/FileWatcher.swift src-native/LocalFileSchemeHandler.swift src-native/NativeBridge.swift tests/native/TestRendererSuite.swift -o /tmp/moread-renderer-bridge-tests && /tmp/moread-renderer-bridge-tests "$PWD/dist-renderer"
scripts.test:native: swiftc -O -module-cache-path /tmp/moread-swift-module-cache -target arm64-apple-macos14.0 -framework WebKit -framework UniformTypeIdentifiers src-native/SettingsManager.swift src-native/FileWatcher.swift src-native/LocalFileSchemeHandler.swift tests/native/TestNativeSuite.swift -o /tmp/run_native_tests && /tmp/run_native_tests
